text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein performs Umra (minor Islamic pilgrimage to Mecca) in Saudi Arabia.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu meets Jordanian ambassador Rifai in Tel Aviv who hand delivers a letter from Prime Minister Kabariti.
- Kabariti also sends letter to Israeli Foreign Minister Levy on bilateral ties and developments in the peace process.
- Cold spell continues with heavy rains and snows on mountain tops and water reserves storage capacity raised by eight million cubic metres.
- Appeals court revokes decision of lower court to free Sri Lankan honorary consul on bail over baby sale charges and again detains him.
- King Hussein's talks with Saudi King Fahd touch on bilateral ties and latest developments in the region.
- Islamist deputy files a law suit against the weekly Abed Rabbo magazine on a complaint it slanders him because it accused the deputy of hypocrisy in an article it published.
- Jordanian ambassador in Lebanon says his country has sent two letters to the Lebanese Foreign Ministry over detention of Jordanian citizen Karmi without receiving a reply so far.
- Floods swamp some areas in south of country and head of public security visits affected areas in the Tafila governate.
